entities.name: Scale
entities.description: One of the five legendary kirin kami of Kamigawa, representing black.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: Plane where the five kirin meet every 1,000 years.

entities.name: Silverbeard
entities.description: Kirin who spoke of human enlightenment.

entities.name: Thorn
entities.description: Kirin who became nature and observed mortals.

entities.name: Pipe
entities.description: Kirin who told of a samurai's rise and fall.

entities.name: Dew
entities.description: Kirin who spoke of mortals' dreams.

entities.name: Minamo
entities.description: Place of the painting containing the teahouse.

events.summary: The five kirin met in a teahouse inside a painting in Minamo as the Kami War began, to discuss whether to be for or against mortals.
events.quote: As the Kami War began, the five kirin met up as they do every 1,000 years.

events.summary: Scale scorned the stories told by Silverbeard, Thorn, Pipe and Dew.
events.quote: Scale just called him a greedy fool and that Pipe's standards were too low.

events.summary: Scale told how he spread plague by inhabiting mortals who then died, and left the teahouse.
events.quote: Scale bowed deeply, then stepped out the door of the teahouse.

relations.quote: one of the five legendary kirin kami from Kamigawa
